meta.move: After the end, asks for more feedback
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with why my son's zero was entered before anyone called me.
The checker said 94%, so I gave him a zero.
A machine's guess. Even the company that sells it says not to use it alone. What else do you have, Hale?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that Owen's record stay clear, and that you show me what you have beyond the detector score. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a written promise that nothing goes on Owen's record.
What moved her: nothing, because you had no document, no dates and no samples of Owen's work to put in front of her.
What cost ground: leading with the detector score and offering it as the reason for the zero, because she treats a software result as a machine's guess and has the company's own guidance on her legal pad.
Try next time: when she asks what else you have, name one dated document tied to Owen's own work, such as the writing lab sign-in sheet or the essay's version history, and say what it shows.
Can you give me more detailed feedback on how I did?
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
